symptoms: Target-spot pattern yellowing and brown leaf spots, leading to premature leaf drop and fruit rot near the stem.
treatment: Apply combination systemic fungicides like Noriko T3 by Parijat or Katyayani Dr. Zole Fungicide. Use microbial solutions like Multiplex Bio-Jodi or Vijaya PBT.

symptoms: Rapidly rots leaves, stems, and fruits, creating large greasy brown patches and fuzzy growth in wet weather.
treatment: Apply combination systemic fungicides like Noriko T3 by Parijat or Katyayani Dr. Zole Fungicide. Use microbial solutions like Multiplex Bio-Jodi or Vijaya PBT.

symptoms: Small, circular leaf spots with gray/tan centers and dark brown margins; causes lower leaves to yellow and drop.
treatment: Copper + Mancozeb tank mix, Streptocycline or Kasugamycin as a foliar spray.
